LESSON: PHONIC AWARENESS (F-J)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Phonic awareness (f-j)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Phonic awareness (f-j), part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: where learner picks a letter 1. Which letter sounds can you remember? 2. Which letter sounds do you like most? Why?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Phonic awareness (f-j) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Responsibility: Hard work as the learner independently matches letter sounds with corresponding objects and plays fishing

games.

● Unity: cooperation as learner plays letter sounds fishing games and sign|sing songs relating to sounds.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Effective communication as a life skill as learner chants rhymes on letter sounds.

Child safety and security as learner becomes more aware of the immediate environment and what to do and not to be safe.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Lnked to mathematics as learner counts the first phonic sounds.
